create_center_crop_image: create a center crop of a torch.Tensor image to a specified target size
create_resize_crop_image: create a resize-then-crop of a torch.Tensor image to a specified target size
create_bicubic_resize_image: create a bicubic resize of a torch.Tensor image to a specified target size
create_find_nearest_resolution_image: find the nearest resolution bucket from a list of tuples for a given torch.Tensor image
create_resize_to_nearest_bucket_image: resize a torch.Tensor image to the nearest resolution bucket using center_crop, resize_crop, or bicubic mode
